History Of Gurkha / Gorkha Army
# The term "Gurkha" is derived from amalgamation of various tribal and hill-based cultures of Nepal, and their history is tied to the unification of Nepal by Prithvi Narayan Shah.
# Their legendary courage was highlighted in the Anglo-Nepalese War of 1814, especially during the heroic defense of the Nalapani fort.
# After the war, Gurkhas were inducted into both the British and Indian armies due to their loyalty and fighting prowess.
